---
type: policy
title: Refund policy
description: How many days a customer has to ask for a refund.
tags: [refunds, billing]
status: stable
verified:
  - by: "human:maria"
    at: 2026-01-10
---
Customers can ask for a refund within 30 days of the purchase. Refund requests
after that period are reviewed case by case. A refund returns the money to the
original payment method.
